Package com.bilt.pos.session.basket

Class BasketLineItem

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.basket.BasketLineItem
public final class BasketLineItem extends Object
An immutable line of a Basket snapshot.

rebateAmount and rebateLabel are zero/null while the cart is being built; they are populated on the baskets delivered during payment orchestration, after the terminal commits offers.

On a return or credit line the totals — originalTotal, adjustedTotal, and taxAmount — are negative; quantity and unit price stay positive counts and catalog prices.
